description:
**Company Description** 
 Offenso Hackers Academy is Kerala’s leading cybersecurity training institute, recognized by Kerala Startup Mission and accredited as a CompTIA Partner. The academy specializes in hands\-on, industry\-aligned programs such as OCSA, OCSP, and ADIS, designed to transform beginners and professionals into job\-ready cybersecurity practitioners. Training emphasizes real\-world labs, live attack simulations, CTFs, workshops, and project\-based internships with strong placement support in roles like SOC Analyst and Penetration Tester. With a Kerala\-based presence and worldwide training reach, Offenso serves students, working professionals, and organizations seeking practical cybersecurity expertise.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Marketing Executive will work full time on\-site at the Kochi location, driving brand visibility and enrollment for Offenso Hackers Academy’s cybersecurity programs. Responsibilities include planning and executing marketing campaigns, coordinating digital and offline promotions, and managing lead generation activities in collaboration with the sales team. The role involves conducting market research, tracking competitor activities, and analyzing campaign performance to optimize outreach strategies. The Marketing Executive will also handle communication across channels, support events and workshops, and maintain consistent messaging aligned with the academy’s positioning.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Market Planning and Marketing skills to design and implement effective campaigns.
* Candidates should possess Market Research skills to understand audience needs, trends, and competitive landscape.
* Candidates should possess solid Communication skills for clear, engaging messaging across online and offline channels.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Marketing skills to support lead generation, conversion, and relationship\-building.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in education, training, or technology/cybersecurity marketing is an advantage.
* Proficiency with digital marketing tools, social media platforms, and basic analytics (e.g., Google Analytics) is beneficial.
* Ability to work collaboratively, manage multiple campaigns, and adapt to a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.

title: Digital Marketing Executive Jobs in Vivo - Kochi, Kerala, India
description:
**Job Requirements**
 Job Title: Digital Marketing Executive at Vivo \- Kochi, Kerala, India
   

  

 Location: Kochi, Kerala, India
   

  

 Salary: INR 2\.5\-4\.25 Lacs P.A.
   

  

 Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related field
   

  

 Work Experience: 1 to 5 years of experience in digital marketing
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you passionate about digital marketing and eager to make a difference? Vivo Kerala is looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to join our team in Kochi. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and wants to contribute to Vivo's online success.
   

  

 As a Digital Marketing Executive at Vivo, you will play a key role in developing and executing innovative digital marketing strategies. Your responsibilities will include creating engaging content, managing campaigns, and analyzing performance metrics. You will work closely with our team to ensure that Vivo's digital presence is strong and effective.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement digital marketing campaigns across platforms, including social media, email, and web, to promote Vivo's services.
* Create compelling content for Vivo’s website, social media channels, and email newsletters to engage and attract customers.
* Monitor and analyze digital marketing performance for Vivo, optimizing campaigns based on data insights.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align digital marketing strategies with Vivo’s overall business goals.
* Conduct market research to discover new opportunities and target audiences for Vivo’s products and services.
* Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in digital marketing to keep Vivo ahead of competitors.
* Manage and optimize digital advertising campaigns, including Google Ads and social media ads, for Vivo.
* Develop SEO strategies to increase organic traffic and enhance Vivo’s online visibility.
* Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of Vivo’s digital marketing efforts.
* Assist in planning and executing promotional events and online initiatives to support Vivo’s marketing goals.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
* 1 to 5 years of proven experience in digital marketing, preferably with experience at Vivo or a similar company.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing strategies and tools, including SEO, PPC, and social media, relevant to Vivo’s objectives.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively represent Vivo’s brand.
* Proficiency in using analytics tools to track and measure Vivo’s campaign performance.
* Ability to work collaboratively with different teams and stakeholders at Vivo.
* Creative thinking and problem\-solving skills to develop innovative marketing solutions for Vivo.
* Familiarity with content management systems and digital marketing platforms used by Vivo.


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary package with opportunities for growth and advancement within Vivo Kerala.
* Dynamic work environment with a collaborative and supportive team at Vivo.
* Access to ongoing training and professional development to enhance your skills and career at Vivo.
* Employee discounts on Vivo products and services.


 Join Vivo Kerala and be a part of our exciting journey in digital marketing. Apply today to contribute to Vivo’s success and grow your career in Kochi!
   

  

**FAQ's**
 1Q: What is the salary range for this position?
   

  

 A: The salary for this position ranges from INR 2\.5\-4\.25 Lacs per annum.
   

  

 2Q: Is this a remote or on\-site position?
   

  

 A: This is an on\-site position located in Kochi, Kerala.
   

  

 3Q: What qualifications are required for this role?
   

  

 A: We require candidates to have 1 to 5 years of experience in digital marketing and hold a Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related field.

title: CBS-BMC-Brand and Marketing-Supervising Associate-Creative Projects Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 At EY Global Delivery Services (GDS), we work hand in hand with the business to build awareness of our services and solutions; to bring our purpose — building a better working world — to life for our people, clients and communities; to engage our people and build a high performing culture; and to build the commercial value and emotional resonance of the EY and the GDS brand.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high\-impact, high\-quality and on–brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human — across multiple media platforms.
   

  

 As a Supervising Associate — Creative Projects Manager, you will be responsible for the end delivery of creative projects within the CoE. You will own the creative and visual direction and design for creative collaterals across multiple formats, ensuring that all creatives are on\-brand, user\-centric and aesthetically proficient. With a passion for problem\-solving and creative strategy, you lead creative brainstorms with stakeholders and content and digital marketing teams to produce best\-in\-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. With your impeccable aesthetic sense and design sensibility, you are a versatile and reliable leader who can elevate any creative conceptualization, storyboard or creative direction for projects across multiple channels.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Act as a single point contact for designated/assigned Creative Services Projects
* Provide creative leadership to the design teams to deliver a range of collaterals (i.e., brochures, placemats, illustration, layouts, infographics, on\-screen presentations, proposals, microsites, motion graphic content and social media collaterals)
* Produce strategically sound conceptual work and bring it to life through rapid prototyping and storyboard creation and all the way through post\-production
* Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet, and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time, budget and efficiency
* Stay up\-to\-date with current and future designs, web standards, concepts and industry trends and advocate the same to team members and customers
* Provide creative and art direction support to the team, coordinate with team members and others to resolve issues, as necessary
* Proactively identify opportunities to employ pop culture trends, creativity, executional approaches and techniques to create exceptional user experiences
* Communicate effectively with various customers/customer groups while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
* Lead project discussions with customers with a customer\-centric mindset
* Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
* Mentor junior team members on best design practices
* Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
* Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A user\-centric mindset with creative, innovative and analytical approach
* Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
* Exceptional project management, risk management and team management
* Proven track record of delivering high\-quality output on time and within budget
* An innovative mindset that takes a client problem and delivers compelling and inspiring creative solutions
* Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Understanding of current and future visual trends


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor's degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline) \*
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe InDesign, Adobe DC and Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word and Excel)
* Experience across a range of digital, social, and integrated media
* Knowledge of social platforms (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest etc)
* Strong visual design and creative thinking capability
* At least 10 years of overall experience in a fast\-paced global environment (team management experience mandatory)


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Preferable knowledge of Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics skills


**What We Look For**
* Strong business acumen along with creative vision
* Creative problem\-solving mindset with a flexible can\-do attitude
* A growth mindset creative who loves to collaborate, ideate and deliver breakthrough work
* Experience in leading and managing creative teams, as well as developing junior creative talent
* Self\-starter who loves challenges and makes big things happen by working together
* Experience working with global clients
* Confidence, maturity and ability to build strong client relationships
* A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others


**What We Offer**
 EY GDS is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to creative consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Performance Marketing Manager (Google Ads + Meta Ads)
description:
Performance Marketing Manager (Google Ads \+ Meta Ads) ElloMind \| Kochi, Kerala (Hybrid/Remote) \| Full\-time \| 3\-6\+ years
 



 Most performance marketing roles give you a slice of the funnel. This one gives you the whole thing.
 



  





**ABOUT ELLOMIND** 




  





 ElloMind is an online therapy platform connecting people with qualified, psychologists, serving Kerala and the global Indian community across the Gulf, UK, US and Canada.
 



 We're not a lead\-gen business. We've built the full product: online booking, secure payments, therapist scheduling, and end\-to\-end client management. Which means you'll be able to see exactly what your spend turns into \- someone who booked, paid, and came back.
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




  




* You'll own paid acquisition across Google Ads and Meta Ads, from strategy and execution through to optimisation and reporting.
* Your success is measured by CAC, conversion to paying clients, retention and marketing efficiency. Not impressions. Not clicks.
* If you like solving growth problems with data, experimentation and commercial thinking, let's talk.



  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




  




* Build, launch and scale campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads
* Drive acquisition across Kerala, the GCC, the US, the UK and Canada
* Optimise for actual paid therapy bookings, not leads
* Own conversion tracking: GA4, Meta CAPI, Enhanced Conversions, offline conversion imports
* Run continuous A/B tests across audiences, creatives, landing pages and campaign structures
* Brief the creative team on what messaging and formats to test
* Manage budgets and improve efficiency through ongoing optimisation
* Report weekly on CAC, ROAS, cost per paying client, LTV and payback period



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




  





**Must have** 




  




* 3\+ years hands\-on with Google Ads and Meta Ads
* A track record of managing meaningful budgets with measurable business outcomes
* Experience in healthcare, wellness, education, finance or another regulated/restricted category, and a solid grip on Meta's ad policies
* Multi\-country campaign experience with international audiences
* Strong analytical instincts; comfortable with GA4 and attribution data
* Able to explain business performance through CAC, LTV, ROAS, and conversion rates
* Happy to walk us through past campaigns: what worked, what didn't, and why



  





**Nice to have** 




  




* Familiarity with Kerala or the Malayalam\-speaking market
* Experience with subscription, recurring revenue or repeat\-purchase businesses
* Offline conversion imports or server\-side tracking implementation
* Understanding of healthcare consumer journeys and trust\-building marketing



  





**WHY JOIN US** 




  




* Own growth, instead of managing small pieces of it
* Work directly with the founders and shape business strategy
* Build campaigns that widen access to quality mental healthcare
* Real freedom to experiment, test, and move quickly
* Transparent metrics and a culture built around learning and outcomes



  





**HIRING PROCESS** 




  




1. Apply via LinkedIn, or email your CV to team@ellomind.com
2. Short application form (link shared once we've reviewed your application)
3. Practical assignment (\~90\-120 minutes)
4. Interview with the founders



 ﻿
 



 We read every application. If you're on the fence about whether you're a fit, apply anyway and tell us why.
